## Summary
Cache SL Country (not PHI, rarely changes). Do not cache get_patient responses in a shared key: they are PHI and permission-filtered per user. If patient caching is measured to be needed, key it per user and invalidate on update, and keep the audit line on every hit.

## Findings
| id | severity | category | location | evidence | recommendation |

| ARC-001 | high | security | sample-app/spice_lite/spice_lite/api/fhir.py:60 | `return patient_to_fhir(doc.as_dict())` | A `@redis_cache` on get_patient with the default `user=None` shares one cached response across users: a user without permission gets another user's PHI. Only with `user=True`, or not at all. |
| ARC-002 | medium | correctness | sample-app/spice_lite/spice_lite/clinical/doctype/sl_patient/sl_patient.py:36 | `def on_update(self):` | Invalidate explicitly in on_update (`get_patient_cached.clear_cache()` or `frappe.cache.delete_value(key)`); nothing expires a cached value when the document changes. |
| ARC-003 | low | performance | sample-app/spice_lite/spice_lite/clinical/doctype/sl_country/sl_country.py:9 | `class SLCountry(Document):` | SL Country is a safe candidate: `frappe.get_cached_doc("SL Country", code)` (cleared by Frappe on save). |
| ARC-004 | medium | security | sample-app/spice_lite/spice_lite/audit.py:31 | `def log_access(action: str, doctype: str, names=None, **counts) -> dict:` | A cache hit must still call log_access; put the cache below the audit call. |

## Decisions
- Chosen: cache SL Country only; measure get_patient before caching it.
- Rejected: shared Redis cache of FHIR responses (PHI across users, stale after edits).
